summary: Molecular Partners AG filed a Form 6-K on July 2, 2026, attaching a press release announcing first patient dosing in a Phase 1/2a trial of MP0712, a DLL3-targeting Radio-DARPin developed with Orano Med. No financial terms, board actions, or special-situation mechanics are disclosed. The filing is a routine operational update on clinical progress, not a transformative event. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. As a foreign private issuer, a Form 6-K often covers ordinary business developments. What to watch: upcoming clinical data readouts in 2026-2027.
